bullets: Oct 21 close: S&P 500 +0.73% to 7,768.86, Nasdaq +1.27%, VIX -4% to 16.62; Nvidia, AMD led, Netflix -4% on guidance cut.
10Y yield steady near 5.11%; Brent eased to ~$108.8, WTI ~$102 on US-Iran talk hopes. Refiners sliding on Russian diesel deal and sanctions waivers.
Asia bounced: KOSPI +3.5%, Nikkei +1.4% Wednesday, Samsung and SK Hynix up 3-4%, though KOSPI still down 17% over a month.
Today: jobless claims 8:30 ET (200K est). Tesla, Meta, IBM, Lam, TXN reported after close; check reactions. Valero reports pre-open. Fed in blackout to Oct 29.
Tech/AI-hardware and cybersecurity dips look sector-driven and are bouncing; favor them over refiners, which all have earnings inside the hold window.
